quality_dimensions.A_data: Passed scoped keys, source hashes, route/position availability, units, stale/missing semantics and duplicate checks.
quality_dimensions.B_model: Passed whole-trip chronological and tenant isolation checks. No model trained; targets not opened.
quality_dimensions.C_engineering: Passed serialized-state, source-drift, atomic publication, full unit suite and deterministic replay checks. No new third-party dependencies; pip check passed. Dedicated vulnerability scan not run for this local feature-only change.

quality_dimensions.E_external_validity: Synthetic-only; linear fictional route motion can make GPS predictors unusually informative. Real-road evaluation remains required.

records.classification: observed contract gap, not an M3a prediction bug
records.finding: Upstream low_confidence snapshots retain stale GNSS speed, while remaining distance is null.
records.impact: A candidate model could misinterpret stale speed as a current measurement without an explicit boundary.
records.root_cause: The snapshot stores source observations; the new model feature layer must define current-use semantics.
records.resolution: New feature contract masks stale speed and remaining distance, retaining age/quality and row identity.
records.verification: tests/test_features.py stale boundary/masking tests; 4,016 stale original-training rows audited as masked.
records.status: addressed and verified in feature preparation
records.limitation: M3a did not use GPS; no earlier baseline error or improved accuracy is claimed.

records.finding: Near-linear route progression and distance/motion-time-based speed can strongly encode the synthetic generator law.
records.impact: Later GPS-based candidate gains may not generalize to real traffic, routes or reporting delays.
records.resolution: Disclose the limitation; evaluate later candidate results only within the synthetic experiment.
records.verification: Read source generation logic; no real-world performance validation performed.
records.status: open limitation for later modeling and real-data validation

preventive_control.classification: preventive risk, not observed operational failure
preventive_control.status: stage controls verified; continue through candidate integration
preventive_control.controls: Positive feature allowlist; no target source reads; per-fold/per-tenant fitting; protected-role gate; future-source and payload mutation tests.
